rules: If e8RawCandidateAbsoluteMs exists, use the DDC parabolic raw candidate
For a DDC candidate, use its same-song opposite-fold DDC correction when that record has at least 3 pairs and usedFallback=false
If the DDC correction record used fallback, use the frozen E5 correctionMs for the same song and fold instead of 0 ms
If no DDC candidate exists, use the frozen E5 calibrated candidate and error unchanged
If neither candidate exists, remain missing
selectionPolicy: Deterministic per-object availability and calibration-support rule; no sample-id gate, confidence threshold, score comparison or post-hoc override
primaryMetric: Population-weighted clear+approximate +/-5 ms correct rate using absolute candidate time, missing candidates incorrect
guardrails: sample-044 audible correct rate at least 80%
report candidate coverage and every candidate/correction source

hypotheses.H1: E9 improves weighted audible +/-5 ms correct rate over E5
hypotheses.H2: E9 has positive net fixed weight versus E5, preserves sample-044 at least 80%, and does not increase no-clear output rate
hypotheses.H3: Every candidate and correction source can be independently reconstructed from v567 without new inference or labels beyond frozen crossfit

testPolicy: Exactly one complete hierarchical fallback rule; no direct-DDC-only alternative, different fallback threshold, official peaks, rematching or per-song selection
confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels
